caseNameFull: Rodriguez v. Alcoa Steamship Co., Inc.
attorneys: Harvey B. Nachman and Stanley L. Feldstein for petitioner., Antonio M. Bird, J. Ward O’Neill and Francis X. Bym for respondent.

opinions.text:
C. A. 1st Cir. Certiorari denied.

Mr. Justice Black is of the opinion that certiorari should be granted and the judgment reversed. Mr. Justice Douglas is of the opinion that certiorari should be granted.
